policy_study_as_reported.definition: immediate_exit_mean_pnl_atr - held_to_c1_mean_pnl_atr on flagged trades in 2024

reconciliation_verdict.explanation: In both studies, the formula was identical: (Immediate Mark PnL) - (Held to C1 PnL). However, under the leaked policy model, the model selected trades whose regime peak ran away to -10A to -82A (because ext_mag used future cur_peak). Thus, the held-to-C1 mean was an artificial -6.21 ATR. When recomputed using strictly causal features on the exact same P0 rows, held-to-C1 mean on flagged trades is -1.1666 ATR and immediate exit is -0.7528 ATR, yielding a genuine loss avoided of +0.4137 ATR, completely in line with the observational study's +0.6072 ATR.
